options.content:
# Network Topology — test-harness view

This panel renders the live topology discovered by **network-topology-exporter**, built entirely from two Prometheus metrics it emits — `network_topology_device_info` and `network_topology_edge_info` (reshaped in-panel with PromQL + a SQL expression).

**How to read it**
- **Node** = a discovered device. Title = hostname; subtitle = vendor (model appended when available).
- **Ring** = the mix of discovery protocols that found this device's links (LLDP, CDP, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, FDB, MPLS-TE), as proportions that sum to 1. A solid single-colour ring means the device is seen by only one protocol; a multi-colour ring shows the split. Isolated devices (no links) have no ring.
- **Number inside the node** = its link count (degree), counted across both endpoints.
- **Edge** = a discovered link. Label is `src_port → dst_port`; hover for discovery protocol, link kind, and direction (bidirectional = confirmed from both ends).

**What richer SNMP data could add here** *(not collected today — illustrative)*
- **Link speed / bandwidth** (IF-MIB `ifHighSpeed`) → edge **thickness**
- **Interface utilisation / errors / discards** → edge colour or width
- **Device health** (CPU, memory, temperature, uptime) → node colour or stat
- **Admin / oper status** → dashed vs solid edges

> **Note:** This dashboard exists only to **validate the topology exporter** against the long-running test lab — it is not an operational NOC view. The enrichments listed above show what the SNMP data model *could* drive; they are not part of what the exporter emits today.

targets.expr: count by (node_id, discovery_proto) (label_replace(network_topology_edge_info{tester_id="$tester_id"}, "node_id", "$1", "src_device", "(.*)") or label_replace(network_topology_edge_info{tester_id="$tester_id"}, "node_id", "$1", "dst_device", "(.*)")) / on (node_id) group_left() count by (node_id) (label_replace(network_topology_edge_info{tester_id="$tester_id"}, "node_id", "$1", "src_device", "(.*)") or label_replace(network_topology_edge_info{tester_id="$tester_id"}, "node_id", "$1", "dst_device", "(.*)"))

count by (node_id) (label_replace(network_topology_edge_info{tester_id="$tester_id"}, "node_id", "$1", "src_device", "(.*)") or label_replace(network_topology_edge_info{tester_id="$tester_id"}, "node_id", "$1", "dst_device", "(.*)")) or count by (node_id) (label_replace(network_topology_device_info{tester_id="$tester_id"}, "node_id", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)")) * 0

targets.expression:
SELECT n.id, n.title, n.subTitle,
  CAST(CAST(MAX(d.__value__) AS SIGNED) AS CHAR) AS secondaryStat,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.discovery_proto = 'lldp' THEN a.__value__ ELSE 0 END) AS arc__lldp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.discovery_proto = 'cdp' THEN a.__value__ ELSE 0 END) AS arc__cdp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.discovery_proto = 'bgp' THEN a.__value__ ELSE 0 END) AS arc__bgp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.discovery_proto = 'ospf' THEN a.__value__ ELSE 0 END) AS arc__ospf,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.discovery_proto = 'fdb' THEN a.__value__ ELSE 0 END) AS arc__fdb,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.discovery_proto = 'isis' THEN a.__value__ ELSE 0 END) AS arc__isis,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.discovery_proto = 'mpls_te' THEN a.__value__ ELSE 0 END) AS arc__mpls_te,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.discovery_proto = 'configured' THEN a.__value__ ELSE 0 END) AS arc__configured
FROM Nodes n
LEFT JOIN ArcData a ON n.id = a.node_id
LEFT JOIN Degree d ON n.id = d.node_id
GROUP BY n.id, n.title, n.subTitle
LIMIT 500
SELECT id, source, target, mainStat, secondaryStat, detail__protocol, detail__direction FROM Edges LIMIT 2000
